note: Frozen, version-controlled splits. Source of truth is the CSV; MANIFEST.json pins counts+sha256. Regenerate via make_splits.py.

lp_edrscc_v1.description: LP-PDBBind new_split ∩ ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8), non-covalent

time_v1.description: temporal holdout: train ≤2016, val 2017, test ≥2018; quality bar = non-cov ∧ lig&poc RSCC ≥ 0.8
time_v1.generalization: temporal (NOT sequence-dedup — recent test target may match a train one)

misato_md_v1.description: mirror of MISATO official 8:1:1 MD split (train/val/test_MD.txt), lowercased

lp_edrscc_v2.description: lp_edrscc_v1 ∩ (Kd or Ki) — IC50 dropped; ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8), non-covalent
lp_edrscc_v2.generalization: novel-target (sequence-dedup); Kd/Ki-only affinity labels (no assay-dependent IC50)

clean_ed_v1.description: GEMS PDBbind CleanSplit (leakage + intra-train redundancy filtered) ∩ ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8) ∩ (Kd or Ki), non-covalent; test = CASF-2016
clean_ed_v1.partition: CleanSplit released lists (train / fold-0 val / CASF-2016)
clean_ed_v1.generalization: de-leaked (protein+ligand) AND redundancy-reduced training; CASF-2016 held-out test
clean_ed_v1.reference: Gao/Durairaj et al., 'Resolving data bias improves generalization in binding affinity prediction', Nat. Mach. Intell. 2025; code camlab-ethz/GEMS

clean_ed_v1_indep.description: GEMS PDBbind CleanSplit (leakage + intra-train redundancy filtered) ∩ ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8) ∩ (Kd or Ki), non-covalent; test = CASF-2016 leakage-independent subset
clean_ed_v1_indep.partition: CleanSplit released lists (train / fold-0 val / CASF-2016 leakage-independent subset)
clean_ed_v1_indep.generalization: de-leaked (protein+ligand) AND redundancy-reduced training; CASF-2016 held-out test
clean_ed_v1_indep.reference: Gao/Durairaj et al., 'Resolving data bias improves generalization in binding affinity prediction', Nat. Mach. Intell. 2025; code camlab-ethz/GEMS

lp_edrscc_v2_cl1.description: lp_edrscc_v2 ∩ LP-PDBBind cleaning level(s) CL1 (applied to all splits); ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8) ∩ (Kd or Ki), non-covalent
lp_edrscc_v2_cl1.generalization: novel-target (sequence-dedup); Kd/Ki-only; LP cleaning CL1 — a progressively-cleaner subset of lp_edrscc_v2 (all splits filtered)

lp_edrscc_v2_cl12.description: lp_edrscc_v2 ∩ LP-PDBBind cleaning level(s) CL1+CL2 (applied to all splits); ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8) ∩ (Kd or Ki), non-covalent
lp_edrscc_v2_cl12.generalization: novel-target (sequence-dedup); Kd/Ki-only; LP cleaning CL1+CL2 — a progressively-cleaner subset of lp_edrscc_v2 (all splits filtered)

lp_edrscc_v2_cl123.description: lp_edrscc_v2 ∩ LP-PDBBind cleaning level(s) CL1+CL2+CL3 (applied to all splits); ED-available ∩ (lig & poc RSCC ≥ 0.8) ∩ (Kd or Ki), non-covalent
lp_edrscc_v2_cl123.generalization: novel-target (sequence-dedup); Kd/Ki-only; LP cleaning CL1+CL2+CL3 — a progressively-cleaner subset of lp_edrscc_v2 (all splits filtered)
